_about: The eight decks, in the order doc 15 rolls them out. Each folder holds deck.json, slides/, assets/; scripts/export-decks.mjs prints each to public/files/decks/<slug>.pdf. 'leaves' is what doc 15 says the session should leave behind; 'run' is when to run a practice deck.

decks.leaves: Agreement on the why. A named steering group and advisory group. A date for the first direction review.

decks.audience: Advisory group, partner managers, frequent requesters
decks.leaves: Partners know how to work with the team: how requests get an answer, when planning happens, what they will hear and when.
The vision, the roles, what starts now, and the red flags written down.
Every request gets an answer within five business days.
decks.run: The week before the first weekly triage. It can start before the first quarter, and it is the fastest visible win.

decks.leaves: Candidate Solutions arrive in pieces small enough to size.
A plan the team believes it can keep, and the habit of making one.
decks.run: Day 1 of the planning week, before the first session.

decks.step: Practice: sprints and the sprint report
decks.leaves: Ready stories, a sprint goal, and a sprint report everyone can read.
A discovery brief with a decision in it.
decks.run: When the first Initiative goes active and discovery starts on it.
